name: Geometry Kreisker
summary:
At Notre-Dame du Kreisker, the cafeteria has become an obstacle course unlike any other.

You play as a determined student racing through the famous Cafét' du Kreisker. What begins as a simple trip to grab lunch quickly turns into a chaotic adventure filled with cafeteria trays, tables, chairs, checkout counters, vending machines, and countless hazards standing in your way.

As you progress deeper into the cafeteria, you collect stars and tokens to unlock powerful boosts. Coffee gives you extra speed, Coca-Cola provides a temporary shield, lemonade unlocks a double jump, and special snacks can grant unique abilities.

From the first cafeteria tables to the final trophy section, every area becomes more difficult than the last. Only the most skilled players will reach the end of the course and unlock the legendary cafeteria meal waiting for the champions.

Will you survive the ultimate cafeteria challenge and conquer Geometry Kreisker?
